vb_textbox.text: Ensure that you concentrate hard and don't miss the 1.5 second window to input a command- keep both your index fingers on the buttons that you press to select a gnome and keep one of your thumbs on the spacebar so you are ready to collect the mushrooms asquick as you can, all the while focusing intently. Try and spot patterns in the colour of the gnome and the amount of mushrooms it allows you to collect- take a mental note of the ones that result in the most mushrooms and try and select them when you can, avoiding the ones that don't garner as many mushrooms. Use the 5 minute breaks wisely to ensure that you are maintaining your concentration.
